description: The infographic begins with two retro-style illuminated signs appearing from the left, one saying 'RICH INDIANS' and pointing right, the other entering from the right and showing a chef, a woman in a black dress, and a driver in uniform. Text slides in below these signs, saying 'DON'T JUST', then 'NANNIES AND', then 'DRIVERS', and finally 'ANYMORE'. This sequence of text disappearing and new text appearing happens quickly. The second sign then changes text below it to 'NOW HIRING'. The image then transitions to a full-body illustration of a man in a suit, with the words 'LIFESTYLE MANAGERS' at the top, and 'LIFESTYLE' and 'MANAGERS' appearing sequentially below him. This is followed by a close-up of the man holding money, with the text 'AND PAYING THEM UPTO ₹1,50,000' and '1.5 LAKH RUPEES a month' appearing next to the money.
description_orig: An animation showing various service roles drivers, chefs, lifestyle managers and showcasing an amount of 1.5 lakhs rupees as payment.
video_title: Rich Indians are paying ₹1.5 lakh for this?!
